description: South Carolina motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in South Carolina?
questions.explanation: South Carolina helmet law: riders under 21.

questions.q: What does South Carolina law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: South Carolina: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: In South Carolina, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: South Carolina issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
